result_text:
`PromotionService.createPromotion` now trims the code before doing anything else with it (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/service/PromotionService.java`).

The trimmed code is the one that gets validated, checked for duplicates and saved. So `"  SPRING10 "` is stored and shown as `SPRING10`. A lookup by `SPRING10` finds it. Creating `SPRING10` again, with or without spaces, is rejected as a duplicate.

I ran the `Promotion*` tests and they pass. I didn't add a test for the trimming case.

I didn't change lookups. `limitToRegion` still looks up the code exactly as passed, so calling it with `"  SPRING10 "` will report an unknown code.
